Share your Textus theme here: **one comment = one theme.** A bot checks it right away and replies; once a maintainer has reviewed and approved it, it appears on [textus.md/themes](https://textus.md/themes/).

**Copy this into a new comment and fill it in:**

````markdown
```textus-theme
Name: 
Description: 
Chinese: 
License: MIT
```

```css
/* Paste your whole theme here, or delete this block and drag your .css file into the comment. */
```

<!-- Drag two screenshots of the theme below, light appearance first, then dark (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB each). -->
````

- **Update** your theme by editing your comment (each new version is reviewed again; the live one stays up meanwhile); **take it down** by deleting the comment or posting `/remove <id>`.
- Maintainers: `/approve <id>` publishes a theme waiting in `pending/`, `/reject <id> <reason>` turns it down.
- The CSS must be one self-contained file: no `@import`, and every `url()` must be an embedded `data:` image or font. Up to 200 KB.
- By posting, you share the theme under the license you name (MIT if blank; any OSI-approved license).
- Questions and feedback are welcome here too: comments without the `textus-theme` block are left alone.


Full guide: [README](https://github.com/CatVinci-Studio/textus-themes#readme)
